utcTimestamp.description: UTC timestamp with an explicit trailing Z. Local offsets are not portable evidence.

then.description: A non-terminal run carries no finalized verdict; finalized counts are not required.

description:
Authoritative run-integrity state. This document, not summary.md and not run_manifest.json, is authoritative for run_integrity_status (plan sections 4.1 and 4.5).

Artifact Schema 1.6.0 is a CORRECTION-ONLY version. It fixes four places where the frozen 1.5.0 schemas contradicted their own producers and in two cases their own sibling schemas (findings F-P3-3, F-P3-4, F-P3-5, F-P3-6). It introduces no new fields, no metric semantics, and none of the B1/local-analysis structure, which remains Artifact Schema 1.7.0.

Artifact Schema 1.7.0 replaces the repository-URL-centric identity model with an explicit subject model. `subject_key` is the logical identity used to join analyses across runs, revisions and source modes; `repository_url` becomes a nullable source locator and is no longer the primary key. `analysis_scope_hash` identifies the exact source scope whose bytes can affect the metrics. Git evidence is normalized into a status plus a separate reason instead of compound values such as `unavailable_not_git`; readers normalize the historical 1.5/1.6 form without rewriting those artifacts.

duplicate_rows_dropped.description: Identical duplicates removed from execution. Each remains represented in normalized_input.csv with its representative row.

input_row_count.description: Accepted source rows. Reconciles with normalized_input.csv when that artifact is present.

measurement_outcome.description: Aggregate measurement availability, separated from run integrity in Artifact Schema 1.5. `modules/summary.py::measurement_outcome` returns exactly these four values. 1.5.0 listed `unavailable` here while its sibling run_manifest listed `failed`, so every run in which all repositories failed wrote a status violating its own schema (F-P3-4).

optional_output_failures.description: Optional projection failures. These must not change measurement_outcome (plan section 4.5).

skipped_disabled_count.description: Rows accepted but disabled. Retained in normalized_input.csv rather than discarded.

status.description: run_integrity_status. ArchLens writes 'running' at run-directory creation and one terminal value at finalization. It never writes 'interrupted' as a run status; interruption is observed from repository checkpoint evidence instead.
